# Did your ads cause the sales?

> Free ad incrementality calculator for geo and store holdout tests. Paste sales by region, name the test regions and the start date to get the incremental lift with an interval, incremental ROAS, profit after ad spend and the smallest lift your test could detect. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
